title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.22
summary: Faster YouTube browsing, with the current branded Repository preserved during installation.

sections.heading: Current Repository included
bullets: Both editions now include the exact published Repository 1.0.6 and branded icon. Standard update no longer replaces it with the older clean-baseline copy.

sections.heading: Faster YouTube browsing
bullets: Previously loaded recommendations, subscriptions and categories can appear immediately after reopening Kodi.
Overdue recommendations refresh in the background. Explicit Refresh remains available.

sections.heading: Current watched status and account privacy
bullets: Reused rows read current watched and resume information instead of freezing old progress in the saved display.
Saved rows belong to the selected account and content preferences. Account or filter changes retire outdated work.

sections.heading: Your settings and playback
bullets: Standard update retains selected settings, playback choices and authorizations. Platform-specific compatibility fixes remain included.
A first load without valid saved rows still needs YouTube and can take several seconds.
